pages.title: Two Wizard Students Talking Beside Library Shelves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts female Draco Malfoy arguing with Hermione Granger beside the Hogwarts library bookshelves, standing with folded arms while Hermione gestures toward her. Hermione holds two books against her chest, with rows of spines rising behind them. Contrasting straight and wavy hairstyles, wide robe sleeves, and a tall ornamental window create varied sections across this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Female Draco Malfoy Drinking Tea with Narcissa in the Drawing Room of Malfoy Manor Coloring Page
pages.description: Female Draco Malfoy drinks tea with Narcissa in the drawing room of Malfoy Manor in this printable coloring page, seated in an armchair beside her mother. Both hold patterned cups and saucers, with a teapot, covered bowl, and pastries on an ornate table. Curled furniture trim and jewelry provide fine detail among the flowing clothes, curtains, and fireplace panels on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Girl in a Robe and Tie Beside a Peacock Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows female Draco Malfoy walking beside a white peacock among clipped hedges at Malfoy Manor, with the large house behind them. The peacock's crest and trailing eye-patterned feathers contrast with her long robes and pleated skirt. Geometric hedge beds, tall narrow trees, stone urns, and many manor windows add distinct background sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Female Draco Malfoy Examining the Hand of Glory with Lucius in Borgin and Burkes Coloring Page
pages.description: Female Draco Malfoy examines the Hand of Glory with Lucius in Borgin and Burkes in this printable coloring page, holding the shriveled hand near her face. Lucius stands behind her with his serpent-headed cane amid shelves of skulls and bottles. The hand's creases, hanging cage, and carved counter give this coloring sheet intricate details around the larger robe and coat sections.

pages.title: Female Draco Malfoy Choosing Schoolbooks From a Display in Flourish and Blotts Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows female Draco Malfoy choosing schoolbooks from a display in Flourish and Blotts, lifting one volume while holding two others against her robes. Tall bookshelves and stacks cover the shop, with a globe and hanging lantern above the counter. Repeated book spines create many narrow sections around her flowing hair and wide sleeves on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Student in a Suit Beside an Arched Castle Window Coloring Page
pages.description: Female Draco Malfoy wears a tailored sixth-year suit beside a tall arched Hogwarts window in this printable coloring page, standing with both hands in her pockets. A buttoned waistcoat, striped tie, and serpent badge distinguish the outfit beneath her long hair. The coloring sheet combines broad jacket and trouser panels with diamond window panes, stonework, and castle towers visible outside.

pages.title: Slytherin Student Holding a Bird Beside an Open Cage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features female Draco Malfoy taking a small bird from its hanging cage on Hogwarts' seventh floor, with the bird perched on her finger. Her other hand holds the cage door open beside a stone arch and winding staircase. Narrow cage bars, chain links, and feather shapes add fine details around the long hair and broad sleeves on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Slytherin Girl Holding a Coin Beneath Stone Arches Coloring Page
pages.description: Female Draco Malfoy examines an enchanted Galleon used to communicate with Madam Rosmerta in this printable coloring page, holding the coin beside her face beneath Hogwarts arches. A small profile portrait and dotted border decorate the coin, while a serpent badge and striped tie mark her school uniform. This coloring sheet places those compact details among wide robe folds, long hair, and stone columns.

pages.title: Female Draco Malfoy Practicing Occlumency with Bellatrix Lestrange at Malfoy Manor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows female Draco Malfoy practicing Occlumency with Bellatrix Lestrange at Malfoy Manor, sitting with closed eyes as Bellatrix holds her hands near her head. Bellatrix's curls, skull pendant, and decorated bodice contrast with Draco's school robes and clasped hands. An ornate chair, carved fireplace, candles, and serpent crest add intricate background sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Female Draco Malfoy Confiding in Moaning Myrtle Beside the Hogwarts Bathroom Sinks Coloring Page
pages.description: Female Draco Malfoy confides in Moaning Myrtle beside the Hogwarts bathroom sinks in this printable coloring page, leaning close with one hand raised beside her mouth. Myrtle wears round glasses and pigtails, holding her hands together as she listens. The coloring sheet includes oval basins, small taps, and tall pointed mirrors, with larger robe sections surrounding the two students' detailed faces and hair.

pages.title: Female Draco Malfoy Lowering Her Wand in Front of Dumbledore on the Astronomy Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts female Draco Malfoy lowering her wand in front of Dumbledore on the Astronomy Tower, facing him beneath the open stone arches. Her wand points toward the floor as Dumbledore stands opposite in long robes and a patterned hat. An armillary sphere, carved railing, and distant rooftops give the coloring sheet smaller details around the two figures' broad clothing panels.

pages.title: Slytherin Student Between Two Robed Figures Coloring Page
pages.description: Female Draco Malfoy reunites with Lucius and Narcissa at a Great Hall table after the Battle of Hogwarts in this printable coloring page, seated between her parents. Their hands rest on her shoulders and upper arm as the family leans close together. Long hair, draped sleeves, and small jewelry details fill the foreground of this coloring sheet, with rows of goblets and pointed windows behind them.

pages.title: Slytherin Student Watching Quidditch from the Stands Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows female Draco Malfoy watching the Quidditch World Cup from the Top Box with Lucius and Narcissa, above a serpent banner. Draco props her chin on one hand while Lucius holds his snake-headed cane beside the curtain. Tiny broomstick riders, tall goal hoops, and rows of spectators add fine background shapes to the broad clothing sections in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adult Female Draco Malfoy Seeing Scorpius Off Beside the Hogwarts Express Coloring Page
pages.description: Adult female Draco Malfoy sees Scorpius off beside the Hogwarts Express in this printable coloring page, resting a hand against his cheek as he looks up. Scorpius wears a school robe and carries a backpack beside the train's open doorway. Stacked trunks and a tall platform lamp add background details, while long coat panels and the train windows provide wider sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adult Female Draco Malfoy Holding Her Family's Time-turner in the Malfoy Manor Study Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features adult female Draco Malfoy holding her family's Time-Turner in the Malfoy Manor study, suspending its chain above her open palm. A tiny hourglass sits inside circular rings at the center of the pendant. Bookshelves, candles, a small serpent ornament, and a globe frame the coloring sheet, contrasting with her long hair, fitted waistcoat, and sweeping sleeves.

pages.title: Slytherin Student at a Feast with Floating Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: Female Draco Malfoy sits at the Slytherin table beneath floating pumpkins at the Hogwarts Halloween feast in this printable coloring page, resting her chin on one hand. Carved jack-o'-lanterns and candles hang above the students, with platters of food and goblets across the foreground. Pumpkin ribs, window diamonds, striped ties, and roast dinner shapes supply varied details throughout this coloring sheet.
